target_visual_sequence: genuine former strong or leader stock
meaningful strict-gap or layered strict-gap zone created during the main collapse leg
zone fully unresolved for at least five completed sessions
price moves materially below the lowest meaningful zone boundary
only later makes its first upward return to that boundary

inherited_invariants.strict_gap: Open_t < Low_t_minus_1 on adjacent corporate-action-comparable sessions
inherited_invariants.universe: Main Board and ChiNext, including ST and *ST; STAR/BSE/funds/indices excluded
inherited_invariants.candidate_clock: after persistence and material-depth qualification, exact first completed one-minute bar touching the lower boundary from below
inherited_invariants.blind_chart_end: candidate bar; no later minute or session

high_precision_retrieval_rules.interpretation: all numeric values are outcome-blind audit-retrieval rules only, never strategy parameters

support_feasibility_amendment.timing: before any pilot chart, human pilot judgment, or outcome access
support_feasibility_amendment.initial_misinterpretation: required five completed sessions whose entire traded range stayed below the lower boundary
support_feasibility_amendment.corrected_semantics: fully unresolved means no full fill of the strict-gap interval through its upper boundary; lower-boundary touches before material-depth qualification do not count as the later return event
support_feasibility_amendment.support_only_threshold_amendment: collapse decline floor changed from 35 percent to 30 percent; 30 percent remains a major-collapse retrieval floor and the other formation, gap-width, minimum-persistence, depth, and re-entry rules are unchanged
support_feasibility_amendment.chart_context_guard: a 250-session maximum re-entry lag was added during pre-review visual QA so every chart preserves the prior peak/run-up context and excludes multi-year stale zones; this is outcome-blind and does not use human pilot labels

meaningful_layer_rule: Within the inherited provisional episode, display only strict primitives satisfying the 1.5 percent width floor, the 1-to-40-session post-peak main-collapse clock, at least 25 percent decline from peak, and at most -5 percent five-session return into formation. The candidate boundary itself must satisfy the stricter 2 percent width and full high-precision gates.

semantic_retrieval_score.use: outcome-blind ordering within fixed sampling strata only
semantic_retrieval_score.formula: unweighted mean of eight components, each clipped to [0,1]

sample.selection: deterministic outcome-blind round-robin by board, formation year, and single-versus-layered meaningful zone; within strata order by frozen semantic retrieval score then stable identity hash

forbidden: reading or summarizing incomplete V1 human labels
